title: 上海地铁换乘指南
Shanghai Metro Planner
desc: 少换乘，再少走几站。用图结构和 Dijkstra 算法规划上海地铁路线，支持线路编辑与路径高亮。
A Shanghai Metro planner that prioritizes fewer transfers, then fewer stops. Includes network editing and highlighted routes.

title: IASR 空中态势识别
IASR
desc: 从视频中的目标检测与跟踪，到交通、能见度与异常事件分析。将现场信息整理成可追溯的事件与证据。
Video detection and tracking for traffic, visibility, and unusual events. Turns observations into traceable events and evidence.

title: Bronymap
Bronymap
desc: 在地图上发现同好，同时保留距离。位置在浏览器内转为 10 km 或 25 km 网格，服务器不接收原始坐标。
Find fellow pony fans without sharing precise locations. The browser converts locations into 10 km or 25 km grid cells before submission.

title: 国豪野史
Unofficial GHC Chronicle
desc: 记录国豪书院的校园故事与共同记忆。一部持续生长的非官方网络志书，附有来源与史料置信度。
Campus stories and shared memories from Guohao College. An evolving unofficial chronicle with sources and confidence labels.
alt: 国豪野史仓库中的校园建筑横幅
Campus architecture banner from the GHC Chronicle repository

title: hanhua 游戏与影视汉化
hanhua
desc: Windows 上的 Codex 汉化技能。生成可还原的游戏补丁与实时中文字幕，为电影、剧集制作保留原声的普通话配音和双语字幕版本。
A Codex skill for Windows that creates reversible game patches and live Chinese subtitles, plus Mandarin-dubbed films and series with bilingual subtitles and the original audio.
alt: hanhua 演示：《The Question》的中文剧情与选项实机截图
hanhua demo: Chinese dialogue and choices in The Question

title: 今刻
Jinke
desc: 打开就能写的 Android 心情记录本。自动保存草稿，文字留在本机 SQLite，支持导出 TXT、Markdown 与 JSON。
An Android journal that opens ready to write. Saves drafts locally in SQLite and exports entries as TXT, Markdown, or JSON.

title: LiveCue 临场
LiveCue
desc: 结合简历与岗位资料，把会议语音转为文字和回答要点。支持可选画面观察，使用你自己配置的 AI API。
Turns meeting audio into transcripts and answer points grounded in your resume and role. Optional screen context; bring your own AI API.
alt: LiveCue README 工作台截图，使用本地示例数据
LiveCue README workspace screenshot with local sample data

title: Mentor Match
Mentor Match
desc: 基于可核验证据寻找导师、实验室与研究机会。支持比较候选、生成申请准备材料，以及跟进已保存的名单。
Find and compare supervisors, labs, and research opportunities using verifiable evidence. Prepare application materials and monitor saved shortlists.

title: QQ 画像簿
QQ Conversation Atlas
desc: 把聊天记录整理为可搜索的联系人画像。聚合互动统计、组合筛选与可选 AI 分析，数据存入本地 SQLite。
Turn chat exports into searchable contact profiles with interaction statistics, combined filters, and optional AI analysis. Data is stored in local SQLite.
alt: QQ 画像簿 README 中的聊天关系概览界面
Conversation overview from the QQ Conversation Atlas README

title: QQ Group Advisor
QQ Group Advisor
desc: 为 QQ 社群规划、治理和运营提供帮助。基于授权数据分析目标与现状，产出定位、宣传及冷启动方案。
Plan, govern, and operate QQ communities using authorized data. Develop positioning, promotion, and launch plans grounded in community goals.

title: ScreenAnswer 框答
ScreenAnswer
desc: 框选一道题，把解题参考留在手边。支持视觉模型或本地 OCR，在可置顶的小窗中展示答案，API 由你自行配置。
Select a question on screen and keep a reference answer nearby. Supports vision models or local OCR, a floating answer window, and your own API.
alt: 框答 README 示例截图，展示演示题目和答案
ScreenAnswer README screenshot showing a sample question and answer

title: StrideTune 随步
StrideTune
desc: 让音乐跟上你的步伐。单指滑动调节播放速度，支持本地音频与网易云公开歌单导入。
Let the music follow your pace. Swipe with one finger to adjust playback speed, with local audio and public NetEase playlist imports.
alt: 随步 README 中的 Android 播放器实际界面
Actual Android music player interface from the StrideTune README

title: 循济 TongjiTap
TongjiTap
desc: 离线运行的 Android 多步骤点击辅助工具。支持坐标取点、按住与等待时长设置、有限次数循环，以及可见的开始和停止控制。
An offline Android assistant for multi-step tap sequences. Pick coordinates, set hold and wait times, and run a finite number of loops with visible start and stop controls.
alt: 循济 TongjiTap README 中的 Android 步骤设置界面
TongjiTap Android sequence settings from its README

title: 全球高校教师信息系统
University Faculty Information System
desc: 使用 Python 爬虫与 SQL 数据库整理高校教师信息，支持工作单位、年龄与科研成果查询。由 APJIE 期刊提供资金和数据支持。
A Python and SQL system for querying faculty affiliations, age, and research output. Developed with funding and data support from the APJIE journal.

title: AI 视频课堂
AI Video Classroom
desc: 从学习问题生成课程大纲、中文旁白、示意动画与字幕视频。支持私人课程和社区分享，提供可在本机运行的示例课程。
Turn a learning question into an outline, Chinese narration, animated diagrams, and subtitled video. Supports private courses and community sharing, with sample lessons you can run locally.
alt: AI 视频课堂示例使用的卡西尼号土星照片
Cassini photograph of Saturn used in an AI Video Classroom sample lesson

title: 同济野史
Tongji Wild History
desc: 查访同济校史与校园轶事，按年代和置信度检索文章。段落附中、英、德文来源，区分史实、回忆与争议。

A community archive of Tongji history and campus stories. Browse by period and confidence, with paragraph-level Chinese, English, and German sources distinguishing records, recollections, and disputed accounts.
alt: 同济大学文远楼正面，摄影 Qiu Chaofan
Front of Wenyuan Building at Tongji University, photographed by Qiu Chaofan

title: AGI Relay 大模型中转站
AGI Relay
desc: 基于 New API 的大模型 API 网关，支持统一接入、令牌管理与流式响应。目前提供接入说明和部署配置，线上页面处于预览阶段，等待服务器接入。

A model API gateway built on New API, with a shared endpoint, token management, and streaming responses. Connection guides and deployment configuration are available; the website is a preview awaiting a server.

title: 序铃 DayChime
DayChime
desc: 离线 Android 校园作息应用，将起床、课程与自习安排进每周时间表，按时响铃。支持随课程开始的跨应用专注倒计时，也可单独设置专注时长。
An offline Android schedule for campus life, with weekly routines and bells for wake-up, classes, and study. Start a focus countdown over other apps when class begins, or set a standalone timer.
alt: 序铃 DayChime 的今日作息、每周作息和课堂专注倒计时
DayChime screens showing today's schedule, weekly routines, and the classroom focus countdown

title: Hachile Events 同济活动日历
Hachile Events
desc: 按学院查找校园活动、竞赛报名与比赛时间，并查看赛事目录和奖学金评审依据。支持关键词筛选、本地收藏和 ICS 日历导出、订阅，条目附原始来源。

Find campus events, competition deadlines, and contest dates by college, alongside competition catalogs and scholarship criteria. Includes search, local favorites, ICS export and subscriptions, with links to original sources.
alt: Hachile Events 网站的学院筛选、月历和日程列表
Hachile Events website showing college filters, a monthly calendar, and the event schedule

title: 生辰邮局 Birthday Post
Birthday Post
desc: 从聊天记录整理生日线索与祝福素材，核对后将好友卡传到手机。支持公历、农历生日提醒，在本机编辑并复制个性化祝福，无需账号或 API 密钥。

Extract birthday clues and greeting details from chat records, review them, and transfer confirmed contact cards to your phone. Supports Gregorian and lunar birthday reminders, with greetings composed locally for editing and copying. No account or API key required.
alt: 生辰邮局 Windows 端的生日总览与月历，未导入好友资料
Birthday Post on Windows showing the birthday overview and calendar before importing contacts
